# Persisted-format fixtures

These fixtures include constructed representative payloads and one layout emitted by the repository's original Rust baseline. None is copied from an identified user installation or published release archive.

| Fixture | Format | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `layout_schema_v0.json` | Layout schema 0 | Exercise IDs, panel metadata, floating geometry defaults, plus an unknown extension modality and opaque user payload preserved through migration. |
| `layout_schema_v1_baseline_6987eff.json` | Layout schema 1 | Exact output of the original Rust `serialize_layout` implementation at commit `6987eff` (`crates/doofusdock-core/src/persistence.rs`); covers the supported prior Rust baseline's panel, floating-window, monitor, scale, z-order and checksum fields. |
| `profile_catalog_schema_v0.json` | Profile catalog schema 0 | Exercise list-to-ID-keyed catalog migration while retaining profile and semantic region identities. |
| `window_rules_schema_v0.json` | Rule-set schema 0 | Exercise the current version-1 defaults and schema migration for a legacy rule set. |
| `doofusimage_gallery_preferences_v0.json` | DoofusImage GalleryPreferences source shape, unversioned | Source-derived fixture of the six fields serialized by the current sibling app; used as provider state inside the DoofusDock versioned extension-state envelope. It is not copied from an installed user file and does not prove production host wiring. |

The schema-1 layout fixture was generated by running that commit's serializer from a temporary checkout; its checksum is validated by the current migration test. It is a repository-baseline artifact, not a tagged/released package artifact. Future schema changes should add a fixture for each supported source version, retain its construction/release provenance here, and assert identities, opaque payloads, ordering and user-authored values that must survive.
